svg.title: The Gardener Who Grew Another Morning
svg.desc: The reference shows an expressive undead head with pronounced facial planes, irregular teeth, tousled hair, torn cloth, articulated fingers and a decorated mug. This original gently comic gardener carries over the expressive structure, sewn repairs and handled vessel, without exposed tissue or gore. Exactly 7.000 s, continuous loop: 0–0.84 s quiet attention; 0.84–1.68 s pouring forearm lifts back −4° in anticipation; 1.68–3.78 s forearm tips 12°, head bows kindly and the water fades in; 3.78–5.04 s pour hold, sapling responds with a delayed −3° lift and settling; 5.04–7.00 s water ceases and jug, head and leaves return smoothly to their starting poses. Native SMIL only; every duration is seven seconds.
svg.text: THE GARDENER WHO GREW ANOTHER MORNING
